content: It is important to actually present your argument and provide evidence to support your claims before expecting others to agree that it is airtight. Simply asserting that your argument is airtight without providing any justification is not sufficient for others to accept it. It is important to back up your claims with evidence and logical reasoning in order to make a convincing argument.
